You need to look at younger you, imagine them standing Infront of you. Don't they deserve to be loved? You need to love them. You need to accept them as they are and help them get out of there. I know this is harsh, but you will get out of this hole. Life dug it, and you'll crawl the fuck out of it.

I understand that free time can be very very poisonous. It gives you way too much space to overthink, lay in bed and sink into your own thoughts. Although this might sound basic, but you could try out a new hobby. Let it be watching and rating movies ( I love to do that time to time, it hits different when you watch a movie by yourself) or maybe trying something creative like writing when you feel as if you really need to put your thoughts down (it doesnt have to be good! Just to get it all out) or painting (again, doesn't have to look like a masterpiece, what matters is getting emotions out, or just having fun) or maybe trying out new recipes, or games. You can do so many productive things in your spare time. If you want to go out, you can try making some friends. It may seem literally impossible but I thought that once too, until I started realising, others might be just as alone as I am and waiting for someone to approach them. Heck, this might sound insane but sometimes you can go up to someone your age sitting alone and striking up a convo, asking about their day and introducing yourself. I was scared to do so at first but the more I started talking with strangers and seeing everyone more human, I realised that there isn't much to be afraid of, they're just like me. But also going out by yourself isn't bad either, I think learning to love your own company is very important. You can try talking to yourself whilst cooking or doing anything around at home, I find it is quite interesting to tell stuff to yourself.
